signIn.subtitle: Ragab CRM staff
signIn.errorInvalid: Those details do not match an account.
signIn.errorLocked: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
forgot.submitted: If that address belongs to an account, we have sent a reset link.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.success: Your password has been changed. You can sign in now.
reset.tokenInvalid: This reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
reset.linkMissing: This link is incomplete. Request a new reset email.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.name: Name
profile.emailHint: Contact an administrator to change your sign-in address.
profile.error: That could not be saved. Please check the form.

session.expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

sectionSummaries.organisation: Departments and the people who work in them.
sectionSummaries.ticketing: Categories, priorities, saved replies, and how tickets close.
sectionSummaries.serviceLevels: Response and resolution targets, working hours, and holidays.
sectionSummaries.email: The mailbox tickets arrive in, and the acknowledgement customers receive.

setting.secretSet: A value is saved. Enter a new one to replace it.

organisation.departmentsBody: Departments group agents so a ticket can be routed to a team rather than a person.
organisation.usersBody: Staff accounts and the role each one holds.
organisation.screensPending: Managed through the API today. The screen arrives with the users story.

ticketing.categoriesHint: A flat list. Categories do not nest, so every ticket has exactly one.
ticketing.noCategoriesBody: Add the first category to let agents file tickets by subject.
ticketing.quickRepliesHint: Shared saved text agents can insert into a reply. Plain text — no variables.
ticketing.prioritiesFixed: Priorities are fixed at Low · Normal · High · Urgent and are not editable here.

quickReply.listLabel: Quick replies, in the order agents see them
quickReply.emptyBody: Saved replies appear in the agent's reply box in this order.
quickReply.bothLanguages: Both languages are required. An agent who only reads Arabic cannot use an English-only reply.

serviceLevels.targetsHint: Measured in working hours, per priority.
serviceLevels.workingHoursHint: A day with no hours is treated as closed.
serviceLevels.holidaysHint: One date per line, as YYYY-MM-DD.
serviceLevels.atRiskHint: A ticket is flagged before it breaches, at this share of its target.
serviceLevels.notYetEnforced: These targets are recorded now and start being enforced in a later story.

email.mailboxHint: The mailbox incoming tickets are read from.
email.acknowledgementHint: Sent to the customer when a ticket is created from their email.
email.sendTestHint: Checks the mailbox settings without creating a ticket.
email.testFailed: The test message could not be queued.
email.logPlaceholder: Sent and failed messages will be listed here once email is live.

platform.attachmentTypesHint: One MIME type per line. A type that is not listed is refused on upload.
platform.defaultLocaleHint: Used for people who have not chosen one.

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.placeholder: Configuration changes are already recorded with who made them. The searchable log arrives with the audit story.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.deleteCategory: This will delete the category “{name}”. Tickets already filed under it keep their history, but no new ticket can use it.
confirm.deleteQuickReply: This will delete the quick reply “{name}” for every agent.

blocked.cannotDelete: Cannot delete: {count} tickets still use it.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.immutabilityNote: Entries are written once and never changed or removed — not by an administrator, not through this screen, and not through the API. That is what makes the log worth reading after an incident.

filters.dateNote: Dates are inclusive and read in UTC.

detail.title: Audit entry
detail.redacted: Values that looked like credentials were replaced before this entry was written.

empty.title: No entries for this selection
empty.body: Widen the date range or clear the filters to see more.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to the audit log
forbidden.body: Reading what every colleague has done is limited to administrators.

audit.loadError: The audit log could not be loaded.

search.label: Search customers
search.hint: Partial matches work. Deactivated customers are hidden unless you ask for them.

department.label: Department
department.note: Departments group customers. They never limit who can see them.

empty.title: No customers match this search
empty.body: Try fewer words, or include deactivated customers.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to customer records
forbidden.body: Ask an administrator for customer access.

form.identifiersHint: At least one. A customer with no contact details cannot be replied to.
form.identifierRequired: Add at least one email address or phone number.
form.identifierRepeated: This contact detail is already listed above.

duplicates.title: This person may already exist
duplicates.body: These contact details already belong to {count} existing customer records. Open one instead of creating a second.
duplicates.createAnywayHint: Two people in one household can share a phone number. Create a second record only if this is genuinely a different person.

profile.historyPlaceholder: Tickets and messages for this customer will appear here.
profile.confirmDeactivate: This will hide {name} from customer search. Their tickets, notes and history stay exactly as they are, and the record can be reactivated at any time.

notes.title: Notes
notes.placeholder: What happened, in your own words
notes.emptyBody: Notes are for what you would otherwise keep in your head — what the customer asked, what you promised.
notes.confirmDelete: This will permanently remove the note written by {author}. It cannot be recovered.
notes.tooLong: A note can be up to 5,000 characters.
notes.error: That note could not be saved.
notes.onlyYours: You can only edit your own notes.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to these notes
forbidden.body: Notes are visible to staff who can see this customer.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.emptyBody: Attach the invoice, the screenshot, the signed form — anything the next person handling this will need.
attachments.pendingScanHint: This file is being checked for malware. It will be available to download once the check finishes.
attachments.failedHint: This file did not pass its security check and cannot be downloaded.
attachments.mimeMismatch: That file's contents do not match its type, so it was not accepted.
attachments.typeNotAllowed: That kind of file is not accepted here.
attachments.tooLarge: That file is larger than the limit.
attachments.error: That file could not be uploaded.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to these files
forbidden.body: Attachments are visible to staff who can see this record.
